metadata.title: Investors selling cybersecurity stocks are 'missing the point,' says Cramer - MarketWatch

content.text:
Oct. 29, 6:03am ET
Investors selling cybersecurity stocks are 'missing the point,' says Cramer
CNBC contributor Jim Cramer may have been strangely quiet on X about his team the Philadelphia Eagles of late, but he's up early Thursday to lambast premarket selling of cybersecurity stocks on the back of Fortinet's badly received earnings.
